rules: All 3000 final requests retained; no early stopping or outcome-driven tuning
Evaluation and fourfold independent pilot are newly seeded and shared across compared methods
Four Bonferroni normal/HAC observable bands and two exact binomial audit intervals
Rank-one, disconnected, unbounded, empty and unavailable outputs retained
All-request coverage and finite precision reported separately
The projection is conditional asymptotic response inference, not finite-sample or bank calibration
